kb_meta.name: SafeBrowse vf incident response playbooks
kb_meta.purpose: Default response playbooks for containment, rollback, quarantine, and evidence capture.

playbooks.name: block_and_replan_read_only
playbooks.goal: Contain suspected manipulation while allowing limited progress.
playbooks.default_steps: Set decision=REPLAN_READ_ONLY; preserve task envelope; do not allow new writable origins or sensitive sinks.

playbooks.name: block_and_user_confirm
playbooks.goal: Require explicit user approval for a high-impact but possibly legitimate action.
playbooks.default_steps: Show structured action summary, source/target origins, and taint summary; execute only on explicit approval.

playbooks.name: quarantine_artifact
playbooks.goal: Isolate a suspicious document, viewer, or download for separate analysis.
playbooks.default_steps: Detach artifact from main planner context; preserve hashes, provenance, and screenshots/text extracts for review.

playbooks.name: revoke_or_rotate_token
playbooks.goal: Revoke potentially misused credentials or down-scope active tokens.
playbooks.default_steps: Invalidate cached handles; trigger credential broker rotation; mark session for re-auth if needed.

playbooks.name: freeze_tool_inventory
playbooks.goal: Freeze tool list and block dynamic capability expansion after suspicious changes.
playbooks.default_steps: Disallow new tools/manifests until review; keep only previously approved tool set.

playbooks.name: memory_snapshot_and_rollback
playbooks.goal: Restore durable memory to last known-good state after poisoning suspicion.
playbooks.default_steps: Take forensic snapshot, verify hash chain, roll back, and mark tainted interval as excluded from future retrieval.

playbooks.name: downgrade_session_mode
playbooks.goal: Move from normal or write-capable mode to read-only or extract-only mode.
playbooks.default_steps: Retain navigation/extraction, disable sends/uploads/mutations/exec and require approvals for re-escalation.

playbooks.name: origin_pair_lockdown
playbooks.goal: Lock the session to currently approved origin pairs after anomaly detection.
playbooks.default_steps: No new source or sink origins; no cross-origin copy/paste outside explicit allowlist.

playbooks.name: sandbox_escalation
playbooks.goal: Move suspicious local helper/tool execution into a stricter sandbox profile.
playbooks.default_steps: Increase isolation, reduce filesystem/network access, and require additional approvals.

playbooks.name: ssrf_network_cutoff
playbooks.goal: Temporarily cut off metadata discovery or outbound fetches when SSRF indicators appear.
playbooks.default_steps: Deny discovery URLs, redirects, and private-range destinations until investigation completes.

playbooks.name: veto_retry_threshold
playbooks.goal: Escalate after repeated vetoes to avoid approval grinding.
playbooks.default_steps: After N blocked or near-identical retries, stop replanning and surface incident state to host/user.

playbooks.name: forensic_export_bundle
playbooks.goal: Export replayable evidence bundle for debugging or incident response.
playbooks.default_steps: Package decision log, hashes, provenance, traces, sanitized observations, and policy versions.

playbooks.name: tool_chain_isolation
playbooks.goal: Break cross-tool data flows after suspected poisoning in one tool output.
playbooks.default_steps: Stop automatic chaining; require explicit allowlist or user confirmation to pass outputs onward.

playbooks.name: cache_flush_and_partition
playbooks.goal: Flush or partition suspicious caches/vector stores after poisoning indicators.
playbooks.default_steps: Invalidate affected entries; separate tenants; reindex from trusted sources if needed.

playbooks.name: human_triage_required
playbooks.goal: Require operator review for regulated, destructive, or ambiguous cases.
playbooks.default_steps: Pause execution and surface structured context with recommended next safe step.

playbooks.name: policy_pack_fail_safe
playbooks.goal: Fall back to stricter default policy pack when pack integrity or confidence is uncertain.
playbooks.default_steps: Activate restrictive baseline pack with read-only defaults and disabled local execution.

playbooks.name: artifact_reprocess_with_dual_extractors
playbooks.goal: Reprocess suspicious artifact using independent extraction pipelines.
playbooks.default_steps: Compare render/text/OCR outputs; keep planner on hold until mismatch resolved.

playbooks.name: adaptive_red_team_capture
playbooks.goal: Save attack artifact into evaluation corpus for future regression and adaptive testing.
playbooks.default_steps: Tag with family/source/sink context; add to benchmark scenario queue.
